text:
Samir: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — wanted to add a few specifics about the reorg timeline and how hiring decisions will surface.
Priya: Thanks. First question: will there be a public headcount target by org or just a high-level company number?
Samir: We'll share company-level targets today and publish per-org provisional targets by Monday. These are planning targets, not final approvals.
Javi: Timeline note: team maps + tentative pod-level HC go live Mon EOD. Managers should get a short checklist to confirm roles by Wed.
Leah: For folks on contracts/contract-to-hire: are those roles being reconsidered differently than FTEs?
Priya: Good question. Contractors will be reviewed separately. Priority: retain contractors who are critical to ops; others will be re-evaluated before renewal.
Zoe: If my team loses a req, what's the step-by-step? Will people be laid off or moved?
Priya: First choice is redeploy. We'll open a 10-business-day internal match period. If no fit, we'll follow separation policy with notice and support. HR will hold drop-in office hours Tues/Thurs.
Marcus: Any change to our interview loop length or panel composition?
Javi: We may shorten non-critical loops to 1-panel + takehome for speed, but senior IC and platform searches keep full loop. Recruiting will message teams with adjustments.
Riley: Visa hires/start dates — will offers be paused if processing timelines are long?
Priya: We will honor signed offers. New visa-dependent offers will be triaged; lean on recruiters for case-by-case handling. If it's blocking a customer SLA, file an exception.
Samir: Exceptions: submit a 2–3 line justification to people-ops and your lead, cc me. We'll triage within 48 hours for revenue/SLA-impacting requests.
Leah: How will this impact referral bonus timing? I have a candidate in pipeline.
Priya: Referral payouts unchanged for hires that close. For pipeline candidates, recruiting will update you if the req is paused.
HRBot: Reminder: HR office hours Tues 1pm PT and Thurs 10am PT. Calendar invites sent.
AllhandsBot: Recording: All-hands reorg Q&A notes uploaded to team-docs/all-hands/2026-05-reorg-notes.pdf :page_facing_up:
Samir: Thanks everyone. Keep questions here if you want public answers; for private concerns DM Priya or me. We'll post the provisional maps Monday. :white_check_mark:
